## Changes

### Native Android SDK 2.10.3: [WalletAndroid#220](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/pull/220)

- Wraps the native Android 2.10.3 SDK, which parses the credentials that `finalizeOffers` receives in order.
- On Android, `finalizeOffers` could return fewer credentials than the issuer sent, with no error and nothing in `failedCredentials`. The wallet saved the rest, and the issuer had already issued the missing one. When `finalizeOffers` succeeds, `passedCredentials` and `failedCredentials` now hold every credential the issuer sent between them, and each list keeps the issuer's order.
- The native iOS SDK stays at 2.10.2. It parses the credentials in order and doesn't have this bug.

No change to the React Native API.

## Backward incompatibilities

- None.
